items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Uh, Cottrell, Louis Cottrell. Right. Uh, and, uh, quite a few. I don't remember all of the guys, uh, who all taught us, but they had.

ctx.x: Oh. Levine. Levine. He played saxophone. What was his name? Levine. He was pretty, he was really good. And, and at one time, uh, uh, uh, Sun Johnson, Ralph Johnson's daddy played there. Okay. And, uh, I had heard a lot about Sun Johnson. Okay. And they said that Sun Johnson, uh, all the bands that would come in town would try to draft him to, to join their band. He would never leave New Orleans because he didn't want to leave his family and he didn't want to travel. Yeah. He was a saxophone player. Yeah. Uh,…
